verses.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.pt: Então Jesus falou às multidões e aos seus discípulos,
verses.en_web: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said to the people and to his disciples:

verses.en: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
verses.pt: dizendo: Os escribas e os fariseus se sentam sobre o assento de Moisés.
verses.en_web: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sat on Moses’ seat.
verses.en_bbe: The scribes and the Pharisees have the authority of Moses;

verses.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.pt: Portanto, tudo o que eles vos disserem que guardeis, guardai, e fazei. Mas não façais segundo as suas obras, porque eles dizem e não fazem.
verses.en_web: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
verses.en_bbe: All things, then, which they give you orders to do, these do and keep: but do not take their works as your example, for they say and do not.

verses.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.pt: Pois eles amarram cargas pesadas e difíceis de levar, e as põem sobre os ombros das pessoas; porém eles nem sequer com o seu dedo as querem mover.
verses.en_web: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
verses.en_bbe: They make hard laws and put great weights on men's backs; but they themselves will not put a finger to them.

verses.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.pt: E fazem todas as suas obras a fim de serem vistos pelas pessoas: por isso alargam seus filactérios, ) e fazem compridas as franjas de suas roupas.
verses.en_web: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,
verses.en_bbe: But all their works they do so as to be seen by men: for they make wide their phylacteries, and the edges of their robes,

verses.en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.pt: Eles amam os primeiros assentos nas ceias, as primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas,
verses.en_web: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
verses.en_bbe: And the things desired by them are the first places at feasts, and the chief seats in the Synagogues,

verses.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.pt: as saudações nas praças, e serem chamados: “Rabi, Rabi” pelas pessoas.
verses.en_web: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
verses.en_bbe: And words of respect in the market-places, and to be named by men, Teacher.

verses.en: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.pt: Mas vós, não sejais chamados Rabi, porque o vosso Mestre é um: o Cristo; e todos vós sois irmãos.
verses.en_web: But don’t you be called ‘Rabbi,’ for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
verses.en_bbe: But you may not be named Teacher: for one is your teacher, and you are all brothers.

verses.en: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.pt: E não chameis a ninguém na terra vosso pai; porque o vosso Pai é um: aquele que está nos céus.
verses.en_web: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And give no man the name of father on earth: because one is your Father, who is in heaven.

verses.en: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.pt: Nem sejais chamados mestres; porque o vosso mestre é um: o Cristo.
verses.en_web: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not be named guides: because one is your Guide, even Christ.

verses.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.pt: Porém o maior de vós será vosso servo.
verses.en_web: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
verses.en_bbe: But let the greatest among you be your servant.

verses.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.pt: E o que a si mesmo se exaltar será humilhado; e o que a si mesmo se humilhar será exaltado.
verses.en_web: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
verses.en_bbe: And whoever makes himself high will be made low, and whoever makes himself low will be made high.

verses.en: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.pt: Mas ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque fechais o Reino dos céus em frente das pessoas; pois nem vós entrais, nem permitis a entrada do que estão para entrar.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
verses.en_bbe: But a curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you are shutting the kingdom of heaven against men: for you do not go in yourselves, and those who are going in, you keep back.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque devorais as casas das viúvas, e isso com pretexto de longas orações; por isso recebereis mais grave condenação.
verses.en_web: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque rodeais o mar e a terra para fazerdes um prosélito; e quando é feito, vós o tornais filho do inferno duas vezes mais que a vós.
verses.en_web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you go about land and sea to get one disciple and, having him, you make him twice as much a son of hell as yourselves.

verses.en: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.pt: Ai de vós, guias cegos, que dizeis: “Qualquer um que jurar pelo templo, nada é; mas qualquer um que jurar pelo ouro do templo, devedor é”.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, blind guides, who say, Whoever takes an oath by the Temple, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the gold of the Temple, he is responsible.

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.pt: Tolos e cegos! Pois qual é maior: o ouro, ou o templo que santifica o ouro?
verses.en_web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
verses.en_bbe: You foolish ones and blind: which is greater, the gold, or the Temple which makes the gold holy?

verses.en: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.pt: Também dizeis: “Qualquer um que jurar pelo altar, nada é; mas quem jurar pela oferta que está sobre ele, devedor é”.
verses.en_web: ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated?’
verses.en_bbe: And, Whoever takes an oath by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever takes an oath by the offering which is on it, he is responsible.

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.pt: Tolos e cegos! Pois qual é maior: a oferta, ou o altar que santifica a oferta?
verses.en_web: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
verses.en_bbe: You blind ones: which is greater, the offering, or the altar which makes the offering holy?

verses.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.pt: Portanto, quem jurar pelo altar, jura por ele, e por tudo o que está sobre ele.
verses.en_web: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it, and by everything on it.
verses.en_bbe: He, then, who takes an oath by the altar, takes it by the altar and by all things on it.

verses.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.pt: E quem jurar pelo templo, jura por ele, e por aquele que nele habita.
verses.en_web: He who swears by the temple, swears by it, and by him who has been living in it.
verses.en_bbe: And he who takes an oath by the Temple, takes it by the Temple and by him whose house it is.

verses.en: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.pt: E quem jurar pelo Céu, jura pelo trono de Deus, e por aquele que sobre ele está sentado.
verses.en_web: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits on it.
verses.en_bbe: And he who takes an oath by heaven, takes it by the seat of God, and by him who is seated on it.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque dais o dízimo da hortelã, do endro, e do cominho, e desprezais o que é mais importante da Lei: a justiça, a misericórdia, e a fidelidade; estas coisas devem ser feitas, sem se desprezar as outras.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make men give a tenth of all sorts of sweet-smelling plants, but you give no thought to the more important things of the law, righteousness, and mercy, and faith; but it is right for you to do these, and not to let the others be undone.

verses.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.pt: Guias cegos, que coais um mosquito, e engolis um camelo!
verses.en_web: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
verses.en_bbe: You blind guides, who take out a fly from your drink, but make no trouble over a camel.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque limpais o exterior do copo ou do prato, mas por dentro estão cheios de extorsão e cobiça.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the plate, but inside they are full of violent behaviour and uncontrolled desire.

verses.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.pt: Fariseu cego! Limpa primeiro o interior do copo e do prato, para que também o exterior deles fique limpo.
verses.en_web: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
verses.en_bbe: You blind Pharisee, first make clean the inside of the cup and of the plate, so that the outside may become equally clean.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque sois semelhantes aos sepulcros caiados, que por fora realmente parecem belos, mas por dentro estão cheios de ossos de cadáveres, e de toda imundícia.
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! for you are like the resting-places of the dead, which are made white, and seem beautiful on the outside, but inside are full of dead men's bones and of all unclean things.

verses.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.pt: Assim também vós, por fora, realmente pareceis justos às pessoas, mas por dentro estais cheios de hipocrisia e de injustiça.
verses.en_web: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: Even so you seem to men to be full of righteousness, but inside you are all false and full of wrongdoing.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque edificais os sepulcros dos profetas, adornais os monumentos dos justos,
verses.en_web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
verses.en_bbe: A curse is on you, scribes and Pharisees, false ones! because you put up buildings for housing the dead bodies of the prophets, and make fair the last resting-places of good men, and say,

verses.en: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.pt: e dizeis: “Se estivéssemos nos dias dos nossos pais, nunca teríamos sido cúmplices deles quando derramaram o sangue dos profetas”.
verses.en_web: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
verses.en_bbe: If we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have taken part with them in the blood of the prophets.

verses.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.pt: Assim vós mesmos dais testemunho de que sois filhos dos que mataram os profetas.
verses.en_web: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
verses.en_bbe: So that you are witnesses against yourselves that you are the sons of those who put the prophets to death.

verses.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.pt: Completai, pois, a medida de vossos pais.
verses.en_web: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
verses.en_bbe: Make full, then, the measure of your fathers.

verses.en: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.pt: Serpentes, ninhada de víboras! Como escapareis da condenação do inferno?
verses.en_web: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
verses.en_bbe: You snakes, offspring of snakes, how will you be kept from the punishment of hell?

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.pt: Por isso, eis que eu vos envio profetas, sábios, e escribas; a uns deles matareis e crucificareis, e a outros deles açoitareis em vossas sinagogas, e perseguireis de cidade em cidade;
verses.en_web: Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city;
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, I send you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them you will put to death and put on the cross, and to some of them you will give blows in your Synagogues, driving them from town to town;

verses.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.pt: para que venha sobre vós todo o sangue justo que foi derramado sobre a terra, desde o sangue do justo Abel, até o sangue de Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, ao qual matastes entre o templo e o altar.
verses.en_web: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
verses.en_bbe: So that on you may come all the blood of the upright on the earth, from the blood of upright Abel to the blood of Zachariah, son of Barachiah, whom you put to death between the Temple and the altar.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que tudo isto virá sobre esta geração.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, All these things will come on this generation.

verses.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.pt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas, e apedrejas os que te são enviados! Quantas vezes eu quis ajuntar os teus filhos, como a galinha ajunta os seus pintos debaixo das asas; porém não quisestes!
verses.en_web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
verses.en_bbe: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who are sent to her! Again and again would I have taken your children to myself as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, and you would not!

verses.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.pt: Eis que vossa casa vos será deixada desolada.
verses.en_web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
verses.en_bbe: See, your house is made waste.

verses.en: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.pt: Pois eu vos digo que a partir de agora não me vereis, até que digais: “Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor”. Salmos 118:26
verses.en_web: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
verses.en_bbe: For I say to you, You will not see me from this time till you say, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord.
